reason: Sixty days next to my old system with no contract, and they lend the reader, so I risk nothing but my time. The fee check is what gets me, because I watch every dollar and want to see my real yearly cost on paper. Vietnamese help by phone or Zalo and somebody coming to set it up is what I need.
objection: I don't believe it until I talk to another owner who runs it. Will it still work when the internet drops on a Saturday, and will somebody actually pick up the phone in Vietnamese? $39 is fine, but my card fees are the real money and I don't know if I'll really save.
would_change_my_mind: Calling a Vietnamese owner I know who has used it for months and says the card fees came down and the support answers.
